name: LaserPecker LP1 Pro
tagline: Pocket LaserPecker : ultra-portable 5W for stamps and tiny gifts
tldr: LaserPecker LP1 Pro is a pocket-sized 5W engraver for maximum portability. Legacy line compared to LP4/LP5 : still relevant on used market for micro projects only.
mainObjective: Pocket engraving for stamps, tags, and travel demos

editorialDepth.advantages: LaserPecker LP1 Pro 5W suits makers who sell marks, photos, and gifts more than daily panel cutting. Reasonable open-frame entry price.
editorialDepth.limitations: Skip if you already quote 4 mm+ cutting in production. Not for cast acrylic or bare metal without spray.
